detailed_description: The CSS Flexbox Generator is a precision tool for creating responsive, dynamic layouts using the CSS Flexible Box Module. It provides granular control over flex container properties including direction (row/column), wrapping behavior, alignment (justify-content and align-items), spacing (gap, margin), and order of child elements. Developers can visually manipulate these properties through an interactive UI that updates a live-rendered HTML container, displaying real-time changes to the flexbox model. The tool generates standards-compliant CSS code with vendor prefixes handled automatically, supporting modern browsers and legacy implementations. This eliminates manual trial-and-error coding when building complex layouts like responsive grids, navigation bars, or vertically centered content. Advanced features include nested flexbox visualization, percentage-based sizing controls, and computed style inspection to understand how specific property combinations affect layout behavior. Ideal for developers who need to rapidly prototype interfaces or debug alignment issues without refreshing static code editors.
usage_steps: 1. Select flex-direction from horizontal/vertical dropdown and choose wrapping behavior using the 'flex-wrap' toggle
2. Adjust alignment controls: drag the justify-content slider for main-axis distribution and align-items dropdown for cross-axis alignment
3. Set responsive spacing using the 'gap' input field with pixel or percentage values to define child element spacing
4. Add/remove flex items dynamically through the elements panel to test different content configurations
5. Use the code inspector to view generated CSS with calculated dimensions and copy the final stylesheet output
6. Enable 'Visual Guides' overlay to see margin/padding boundaries and baseline alignment during layout adjustments
usage_examples: Example 1: Creating a responsive photo gallery grid that maintains equal spacing across varying screen sizes using flex-wrap and justify-content: space-between
Example 2: Building a navigation bar with vertically centered icons and text where align-items: center automatically maintains consistent spacing regardless of font size changes
Example 3: Designing a product card layout with uneven content heights where flex-grow ensures uniform container expansion while maintaining visual hierarchy
Example 4: Developing a dashboard interface with nested flex containers to create complex column/row relationships that adapt to dynamic data visualization elements
